reviewSummary: ACCEPT at zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX. Subject and frozen-predecessor custody hold at 0444 with HEAD at D-328, required-now 28, DR-125 and DR-117 OPEN. All 83 cited path/sha256 assertions reproduce against live bytes. The one blocking predecessor finding is landed exactly as its frozen source prescribed: findingDisposition[0] now carries the unlabeled Codex sdk leftover-join.v7 SHOULD-FIX descriptively with no id member, the source title byte-equal, landedAt retained, and identifierMintedByThisLineage false, which also discharges the v8 Claude ADV-1 convention observation. The two remaining disposition ids reproduce as source-assigned in the reviews that raised them. The substantive v7 repair is preserved untouched: summary is byte-identical to the predecessor, the nine obligations form an exhaustive once-each partition, OBL-G20-FX-AUTHORING is classified exactly once in summary.specifiedNotLeftover, and summary.leftoverDesign remains exactly [OBL-SDK-API-RESERVED]. sdk leftover-join.v6 (D-267) remains the named current DR-125 consumer, v7 and v8 stay unrecorded and denied current standing, g20 leftover-join.v11 is unmoved and keeps [OBL-G20-FX-AUTHORING] on DR-G20, the occupancy v2 platform list is quoted rather than invented, basedOn.d328.role is the sole last-heading claimant, proposedLaterWork[0] names v9, and the candidate binds NOTHING.
